name: {{ .service }} · latency < {{ .latency_ms }} ms
description: Share of server spans faster than {{ .latency_ms }} ms. Owner: {{ .team }}.

customSli.indicator:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "{{ .service }}" and span.kind == "server"
| makeTimeseries { total = count(), fast = countIf(duration < {{ .latency_ms }}ms) }
| fieldsAdd sli = 100 * fast[] / total[]
